sentence: This project studies how a pathway in liver cancer cells affects tumor growth, a form of cell death, and attack by cytotoxic T cells.
This project uses laboratory tools to study how hundreds of betacoronaviruses enter cells, to judge the risk they pose to humans.
This project tries to stop breast cancer bone metastases by blocking acid signaling in tumor and immune cells in bone.
This project tries to find which parts of betacoronaviruses antibodies recognize, to guide the design of vaccines that protect against many coronaviruses.
This project studies which brain circuits are engaged when opioid use conflicts with negative consequences or positive alternatives, using relapse models.
This project tries to move genetic findings about atrial fibrillation toward treatments by studying genes, mechanisms, drugs, metabolism and environment.
This project builds statistical methods to analyze how cells are organized and interact in Alzheimer's disease using spatial proteogenomics.
This project combines standard tissue examination with two kinds of optical imaging and deep learning to diagnose lupus nephritis more accurately.
This project builds mass spectrometry tools to study proteins and glycans on cell surfaces in stem cell biology and heart disease.
This project studies how clonal hematopoiesis mutations cause immune suppression in lung cancer and looks for ways to improve immunotherapy response.
This project looks for ways other than antibiotics to remove resistant bacteria from human mucosal surfaces and to prevent and treat infections.
This project provides statistical, computing and data management support to a group of linked research projects.
This project studies how genetic differences in the Lyme disease bacterium Borrelia burgdorferi change immune responses in hosts.
This project tries to find out why the vitreous changes with age, to learn how retinal detachment could be prevented.
This project studies how the structures of seasonal influenza viruses change as they adapt to infect cells.
This project produces adeno-associated virus and lentivirus vectors that deliver Cas9 and guide RNAs for genome engineering in rodent models of disease.
This project studies which bacteria microviruses in the human gut infect and tries to change their host range.
This project tries to measure many types of genetic variation across the whole human genome in different tissues.
This project studies how sperm and egg cells recognize each other and fuse, focusing on membrane proteins of sperm.
This project studies the genetic mechanisms behind seasonal rhythms in animals, using hybrid zones.
